samples.summary: First test's assertions are a weak range check that passes with or without the affinity fix
samples.evidence: `it('End lands exactly on the wrap boundary...')` only asserts `cursorOffset > 0` and `< TEXT.length` (lines 145-146). Any offset inside the block satisfies this, and the pre-fix code also landed End on the first line's boundary (the bug only showed on the *second* End / Home / Cmd+Backspace). So this test verifies the 8px canvas shim wraps the text, not the affinity behavior the file claims to cover, and its name ("lands exactly on the wrap boundary") overstates what is asserted — it never asserts the offset equals a boundary. The genuinely load-bearing coverage is in the other three tests.

searchedFor: grep 'Shift|shiftKey' usage in packages/docs/test/view/visual-line-affinity.test.ts (no shift keys pressed anywhere in the file)
samples.summary: Shift+Home / Shift+End at a wrap boundary (the selection path through the same affinity-aware range) has no test
samples.evidence: handleHome/handleEnd both build a selection range from the affinity-resolved `newPos` when `shiftKey` is true (text-editor.ts:2787-2792, 2800-2805). visual-line-affinity.test.ts only ever dispatches Home/End/ArrowRight/Backspace with no shiftKey (press() calls at lines 142,152,162,167,173-178), so the selection branch of the changed behavior is unexercised: a regression that resolved the boundary to the wrong visual line for Shift+End would still leave this suite green.

samples.summary: New afterEach cleanup branch is itself unasserted and rests on an unchecked jsdom implementation detail
samples.evidence: The added `else { delete window.navigator.platform }` (lines 115-120) is the only code this delta adds, and nothing asserts the platform stub is actually gone after the suite (no test reads navigator.platform post-teardown). Its comment asserts jsdom defines `platform` on Navigator.prototype; if that ever becomes an own property the branch silently does the wrong thing. Low impact — it is teardown hygiene, not product behavior — but the delta ships no assertion for the property it fixes.
